purpose: Reviewed per-facility candidate corrections at stacked, shared-collector, or ramp-boundary locations where geometric and topology heuristics cannot pin the safe directed edge alone. Each correction names the evidence that proves an exclusion or forward boundary rebinding. Global heuristics are deliberately avoided: the up-side Hatsudai entrance anchors onto a collector shared with Hatagaya hundreds of meters from the catalog point, so distance or way-ownership cuts sever real entrances.

entry_boundary_rebindings.reason: The official Meguro coordinate projects beside the downstream ramp edge after the generated ramp-mouth anchor. Treating the anchor as the first RoutePlan edge leaves no forward predecessor and would require a backwards virtual entry transition.
entry_boundary_rebindings.evidence: Pinned OSM topology binds osm.207535708.0.forward.to_node_id and osm.422023169.0.forward.from_node_id to node 2177935839; the official Route 2 Meguro page identifies this as the available inbound entrance.

entry_boundary_rebindings.reason: The generated Shiba Park outer-loop ramp-mouth anchor has no predecessor in the selected graph. Binding the RoutePlan to its immediate downstream edge retains the real anchor as the forward entry transition instead of inventing geometry before the ramp.
entry_boundary_rebindings.evidence: Pinned OSM topology binds osm.4853801.0.forward.to_node_id and osm.4853801.1.forward.from_node_id to node 6389606756; both edges carry the C1 outer-loop membership and the official C1 Shiba Park page identifies the directional entrance.

excluded_candidates.reason: Yoyogi PA (up) access ramp: it leaves the selected graph into the PA's service ways, so the ramp-topology probe cannot tell it from an exit. OSM way 26957080 continues into highway=service ways beside the rest_area polygon named Yoyogi PA (up).
excluded_candidates.evidence: Operator fare search checked 2026-08-04: Shinjuku to Yoyogi prices 860 yen (the full C1 circuit); a drivable up-carriageway exit here would price the pairing near the 300 yen minimum.

excluded_candidates.reason: Segment of the Shinjuku exit ramp viaduct caught by geometric ranking 500 m from Yoyogi; its anchored mouth sits at the Shinjuku gate area, 900 m from the Yoyogi facility point.
excluded_candidates.evidence: Operator fare search checked 2026-08-04: Shinjuku to Yoyogi prices 860 yen; an up-carriageway Yoyogi exit reachable at the Shinjuku gate would price it near the minimum.
